_comment: sCure version registry - newest first. On every release: bump the VERSION file at the repo root AND add an entry here (version, date, notes). The Settings > Versions modal shows this list.

notes: Fast cooling boost: the four LED-cooling fans (left/right/back/door) join the chamber fan in FAST mode
LED fans auto-release when cooling ends, on stop, on a mode change away from fast, and on door abort
Manual LED-fan control is blocked while the fast-cool boost owns the fans
QA: Fast Cool Engages LED Fans test (engage + release verified via /api/state)
First versioned release (versioning reset - single source of truth in VERSION file)
ON/OFF thermostat heating control with 1°C hysteresis (PI removed)
Fixed-duty cooling modes: fast 100% / medium 60% / slow 30%
Heater fan cooldown: 30% for 10 minutes after every heating stop (except door abort)
Real LAN + internet detection (eth0 carrier, live TCP-443 watch)
Component runtime counters (ON-hours per wear part)
Door-open safety abort with 10s grace countdown (Err 6016)
Central error registry + QA tool coverage
